source.title_or_context: Recommendations for sudden cardiac death prevention, and treatment of ventricular arrhythmia in myocarditis In confirmed or clinically suspected acute myocarditis, it is recommended that patients who present with life-threatening VA are referred to a specialized centre. I C In patients with haemodynamically not-tolerated SMVT occurring in the chronic phase of myocarditis, an ICD implantation is recommended.
